summary.name: awesome-selfhosted (awweso.me)
summary.one_liner: awweso.me is a searchable web front end for browsing and filtering the awesome-selfhosted list of open-source, self-hostable software projects.
use_cases: find self-hosted alternatives to commercial SaaS
filter projects by category or popularity
compare popular self-hosted projects by GitHub stars
summary.what_it_does: The page lists open-source, self-hostable projects with a short description, a GitHub star count (for example n8n at 209k), when each was added to the list, and recent commits in the past year. Entries include workflow automation, LLM runners, AI chat interfaces, file sync, photo backup, PDF tools, and note-taking apps. Many entries name a commercial alternative they replace, such as Notion, Airtable, Slack, or Google Photos. The page states that the data comes from the awesome-selfhosted community and is licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0. It is listed in awesome-selfhosted under External Links as an alternative frontend for discovering and filtering the list.
notable: Browsable, filterable front end for the awesome-selfhosted list
Shows GitHub stars, date added, and commits in the past year per project
Data is community-maintained and licensed CC-BY-SA 3.0
Flags archived projects such as ones no longer maintained
caveats: Shows only the listed projects' metadata; the page does not host or run the apps themselves
Star and commit counts are snapshots and may be out of date
